mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting the first methane was the most worthwhile moment: it paid off the reactor assembly while explaining that the product was not yet tank-ready.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the retort was the least engaging step; it was straightforward and gave no further detail.

surprise.text: I was struck that a reaction needing initial heating also needs cooling to carry away its heat.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although each decision had only one offered combination, so I was following the available sequence rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the methane is conditioned for the return journey; the commissioning result leaves a clear practical problem.
